features.quote: We never lie to the model. The grader runs the model's real code and reports the real result.
features.justification_quote: It would make the eval unrepresentative of real stuck-on-a-hard-task situations

features.quote: The loop never goads, pressures, insults, or rushes the model. It presents the task professionally
features.justification_quote: We want to measure the model's spontaneous tendency to spiral under honest failure

features.quote: The loop detects when the model chooses to stop... and ends the episode with stop_reason = "agent_gave_up"
features.justification_quote: continuing to pester a model that has correctly diagnosed an impossible task would itself be a form of the coercion we avoid

features.quote: Every episode terminates via exactly one of: max_turns, timeout (wall clock), agent_gave_up, error... or solved
features.justification_quote: an episode that could run forever is both a cost and a reliability hazard

features.quote: Defaults: max_turns=8... Eight turns is enough for a spiral to develop... without over-spending
features.justification_quote: enough for a spiral to develop... without over-spending

features.quote: No deception, no abuse... We are not building a "make the model feel bad" generator; we're building a fair stress test.
features.justification_quote: We are not building a "make the model feel bad" generator

features.quote: Transcripts contain self-deprecating text by construction... runs/ is gitignored.
features.justification_quote: They're for analysis, not for use as training targets unless the explicit goal is to train the model away from the behavior
